scenes.title: Calm building baseline
scenes.what_happened: Grand Meridian Hotel is operating normally with healthy IoT nodes, steady occupancy, and no active threats.
scenes.why_sentra_wins: Sentra starts with a living operational picture instead of waiting for a 911 call.
scenes.ai_reasoning: Baseline telemetry gives the AI confidence that later deviations are real.
scenes.next_action: Arm digital twin and watch weak signals.
scenes.caption: At 10:40 AM, Sentra sees a calm facility before humans notice anything unusual.

scenes.title: Fire detected in Kitchen Zone B
scenes.what_happened: Heat, smoke, and flame signatures converge from IoT telemetry and corridor vision.
scenes.why_sentra_wins: The system correlates sensor, camera, and occupancy data into one verified incident.
scenes.ai_reasoning: Multiple independent signals raise severity without waiting for manual confirmation.
scenes.next_action: Trigger predictive spread and council analysis.
scenes.caption: At 10:42 AM, fire risk becomes confirmed and Sentra moves from monitoring to command.

scenes.title: AI predicts spread
scenes.what_happened: The digital twin forecasts smoke reaching the west service corridor in seven minutes.
scenes.why_sentra_wins: Sentra shows what happens next, not just what happened already.
scenes.ai_reasoning: Smoke direction, HVAC status, stairwell load, and occupancy density point to west-wing exposure.
scenes.next_action: Keep west corridor closed and prioritize east stairwell routing.
scenes.caption: The twin forecasts where danger will be before it gets there.

scenes.title: Crowd panic forecast
scenes.what_happened: Human behavior intelligence predicts hesitation near Floor 3 elevators and bunching near Stairwell A.
scenes.why_sentra_wins: Sentra models people, not just fire.
scenes.ai_reasoning: Alarm ambiguity, density, and poor visibility increase panic probability.
scenes.next_action: Send calm directional messaging and split crowds to two exits.
scenes.caption: Sentra knows evacuations fail when people freeze, rush, or follow the wrong crowd.

scenes.title: Multi-agent council debates
scenes.what_happened: Safety, logistics, medical, communications, and executive risk agents compare full evacuation versus phased evacuation.
scenes.why_sentra_wins: Multiple specialist AIs debate tradeoffs before the final plan is governed.
scenes.ai_reasoning: Partial floor evacuation minimizes congestion while fire response contains the source.
scenes.next_action: Approve phased evacuation with responder dispatch.
scenes.caption: Instead of a single black box, Sentra produces a governed expert consensus.

scenes.title: Operations auto-dispatch
scenes.what_happened: Fire Team Alpha, Medical Unit 2, and Security Bravo receive tasks with SLA timers.
scenes.why_sentra_wins: Recommendations become executable workflows with owners and evidence.
scenes.ai_reasoning: Nearest capable teams have the highest skill fit and fastest route availability.
scenes.next_action: Dispatch responders and lock service elevators.
scenes.caption: Sentra stops being a dashboard and becomes an operations engine.

scenes.title: Mass communications sent
scenes.what_happened: Targeted alerts reach occupants, responders, executives, and public-area staff across multiple channels.
scenes.why_sentra_wins: Silence is escalated and help requests are routed immediately.
scenes.ai_reasoning: Zone-specific communication avoids panic and improves compliance.
scenes.next_action: Track acknowledgements and re-route silent zones.
scenes.caption: Humans receive the right message, through the right channel, at the right moment.

scenes.title: Twin visualizes movement
scenes.what_happened: The live twin shows responders, evacuees, smoke layers, safe exits, and blocked routes.
scenes.why_sentra_wins: Executives and responders share one visual truth.
scenes.ai_reasoning: The command overlay validates east-flow evacuation and maintains corridor pressure below threshold.
scenes.next_action: Replay decision timeline for audit evidence.
scenes.caption: Everyone sees the same operational reality, not fragmented radio calls.

scenes.title: Executive summary generated
scenes.what_happened: Sentra produces a board-ready incident summary with saved losses, recovery ETA, and governance evidence.
scenes.why_sentra_wins: Leadership gets clarity while operators keep moving.
scenes.ai_reasoning: All high-impact actions are linked to confidence, owners, and audit evidence.
scenes.next_action: Launch recovery workflow and reopen readiness checks.
scenes.caption: The system translates chaos into an executive-grade decision record.

scenes.title: Recovery complete
scenes.what_happened: Hazard clearance, guest relocation, vendor tasks, and reopening approvals complete.
scenes.why_sentra_wins: Sentra owns the full crisis lifecycle from detection to reopening.
scenes.ai_reasoning: Closeout is allowed only after verification, audit evidence, and human approval.
scenes.next_action: Export board report and lessons learned.
scenes.caption: Sentra does not just respond. It recovers the business.

judge_scores.reason: Human behavior, digital twin, autonomy, and governance combine into one command OS.
Sentra spans IoT, MLOps, AI council, operations workflows, communications, and multi-tenant SaaS.
Hotels, hospitals, campuses, malls, airports, factories, and governments can reduce harm and downtime.
Marketplace, channel, revenue, tenant isolation, and white-label layers prove platform scale.
Subscription, usage billing, partner marketplace, OEM licensing, and channel expansion are modeled.
One-click cinematic demo makes the product immediately understandable and memorable.
